choices.content: Count 3 grid squares to the left from \(A\) to obtain \(A'\).
Count 3 grid squares upward from \(A\) to obtain \(A'\).
Count 3 grid squares to the right from \(A\) to obtain \(A'\).

question.prompt: When \(\triangle ABC\) is translated 3 grid squares to the right, how do you locate the point corresponding to \(A\)?

solutions.explanation: To construct a translation, move the specified distance in the specified direction. Counting 3 grid squares to the right from point \(A\) gives the corresponding point \(A'\).
solutions.title: Locate the translated point
